preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
Each string s must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s must be a lowercase letter from a to z.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(self_similarity(s) for s in test_cases))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of self-similarity values for each test case.
